*   **Thursday, Nov 19:**

*   **Friday, Nov 20:**
    *   Priya free: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30
    *   Marcus free: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00
    *   Common slots: 11:00-12:00. This gives us 11:00 and 11:30.

I have compiled a list of all possible 30-minute slots for Priya and Marcus. Now I will share this list with Brad via the shared workspace. This is the most effective way to communicate the necessary information to him so he can proceed with his part of the task.
